title: vicia benghalensis subsp. atropurpurea
intro: Vicia benghalensis subsp. atropurpurea, commonly known as Black Bengal Gram, is a plant species belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Vicia benghalensis subsp. atropurpurea include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce oxidative stress, and protect against cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
